---
description: Validate app correctness, content quality, security, and GitHub publishing readiness.
---

Read README.md, SECURITY.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/CONTENT_STANDARDS.md, and .gitignore. Run npm ci; npm run verify; npx playwright install chromium; npm run test:e2e when tools permit. Inspect known gaps and list failures without concealing them. Check for secrets, ignored third-party reference materials, unlicensed assets, stale exam content and browser persistence issues. Do not automatically publish or push.
